EO 9333 item 1 reads 'For the duration of the war and six months thereafter all positions in or under the Inland Waterways Corporation', an own-terms end. EO 9830 (signed 1947-02-24, effective 1947-05-01 by its enacting clause) revokes 'No. 9333 of April 19, 1943' in Part III, so the order ended no later than 1947-05-01. Which came first depends on when 'the war' ended for this clause: if the war ended on or before 1946-10-31 the own-terms end precedes the revocation. No held source fixes that date (candidate readings include 1945-09-02, 1946-12-31 and the 1947 joint resolution ending the war), so the first-end date is not established.

Missing source: a held authority (Civil Service Commission determination, proclamation or statute) fixing the end of 'the duration of the war' for Schedule A exceptions, or Commission records showing when the exception ceased.
EO 9830 naming of EO 9333 is located in the official Federal Register text but the dossier has no ACT record for it (target provision not located: EO:9830).

Section 2 operates only 'During the period the Civil Service Commission is operating under the War Service Regulations prescribed pursuant to Executive Order No. 9063 of February 16, 1942'. EO 9691 (signed 1946-02-04, held) revoked EO 9063 in section 9 and required in section 3 that not later than thirty days after the order all actions be made under the Civil Service Rules, so section 2's period ended on an undetermined date between 1946-02-04 and about 1946-03-06. No held source fixes the date the Commission stopped operating under the War Service Regulations.

Sections 1(a) and 1(b) overlap with EO 9691 section 8, which separately authorizes classified or probational status for ten-per-cent disabled veterans on war-service indefinite appointments. EO 9691 does not name EO 9644, and no held source shows that it extinguished section 1.
EO 9830 (effective 1947-05-01) revokes 'No. 9644 of October 19, 1945' by name and would be the whole-order end if the section 2 date were fixed; the first-end date of section 2 is the open question.
Missing source: Civil Service Commission order or notice ending the War Service Regulations.
